title: Should you go into private practice as a psychologist? with Thomas Gourley Trainee Clinical Psychologist - DClinpsy

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了用时间换金钱以外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在 2022 年完成该项目的，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth, and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫 Beth，是一名来自纽卡斯尔的心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我只想对《临床心理学家集体》一书的撰稿人们表示最诚挚的感谢。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢读这本书，也很高兴能深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 看到申请过程中潜在的障碍以及我如何尝试克服这些障碍，真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology Doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我曾经非常怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否足够优秀去申请临床心理学博士学位。

sentences.en: But this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这本书确实给了我所需要的信心，让我愿意去尝试一下。

sentences.en: So the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: Coming up on today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, I talked to Dr. Marianne Trent about her journey from the NHS into her own private practice.
sentences.zh: 在今天这期《有抱负的心理学家》播客中，我采访了 Marianne Trent 博士，谈论了她从英国国家医疗服务体系 (NHS) 转型到拥有自己私人诊所的历程。

sentences.en: We drop in to Marianne starting third year of her doctorate and we go through the journey into qualification through some years working in the NHS service as a qualified and then blended and eventually full time into private practice.
sentences.zh: 我们从 Marianne 博士训练的第三年开始聊起，回顾了她获得资格后的职业生涯，包括在 NHS 服务工作几年，然后兼职，最终全职进入私人诊所的过程。

sentences.en: Talk a little bit about standardised ways of working, the skills and knowledge and also how it feels and what kind of person maybe would succeed in private practice.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了一些标准化的工作方式、所需的技能和知识，以及在私人诊所工作的感觉，还有什么样的人可能适合在私人诊所取得成功。

sentences.en: We cover a little bit of the pros and cons including what both private and NHS can potentially uniquely offer for clients and we also finish with some kind of big old reflections on the future.
sentences.zh: 我们简要讨论了利弊，包括私人诊所和 NHS 能为客户提供的独特价值，最后我们对未来进行了一些深刻的反思。

sentences.en: Word of warning, this episode is a little bit longer than usual, clocking in about an hour and 20 minutes but obviously you can duck in and out of that at your leisure.
sentences.zh: 温馨提示，本期节目比平时稍长，大约一个小时二十分钟，但你当然可以根据自己的时间随时进出收听。

sentences.en: So thank you for listening, hope you enjoy it and see you soon.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，希望你喜欢，我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent, but wait, I know what you're thinking, this isn't Dr. Marianne Trent, who is this guy?
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听由 Marianne Trent 博士主持的《有抱负的心理学家》播客。等等，我知道你在想什么，这不是 Marianne Trent 博士，这家伙是谁？

sentences.en: Why is he here and what's going on?
sentences.zh: 他为什么在这里，发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Dear listener, worry not, allow me to explain.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的听众，别担心，请允许我解释一下。

sentences.en: My name is Thomas Gawley and aside from lots of other things in my life, I'm also a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我叫 Thomas Gawley，除了生活中做的许多其他事情外，我还是一名临床心理学实习生。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, I was a guest on the podcast and Marianne and I talked afterwards about topics for future episodes.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我曾是该播客的嘉宾，之后 Marianne 和我讨论了未来节目的主题。

sentences.en: I said I'd be really interested to hear an episode about working privately and Marianne's journey from the NHS into her own practice.
sentences.zh: 我说我非常有兴趣听一期关于私人执业以及 Marianne 从 NHS 到拥有自己诊所的历程的节目。

sentences.en: Marianne agreed that this would make an interesting topic, but what might not be too interesting for listeners would be, in Marianne's own words,
sentences.zh: Marianne 同意这是一个有趣的话题，但用她自己的话说，对听众来说可能不太有趣的是：

sentences.en: to listen to her waffle on to herself about her own career.
sentences.zh: 听她一个人喋喋不休地讲自己的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Instead, she suggested that it would be far better to be interviewed herself.
sentences.zh: 相反，她建议由别人来采访她会好得多。

sentences.en: And so the pyramid has been inverted and the former podcast guest becomes the current podcast hoSt.
sentences.zh: 于是金字塔倒转了，前播客嘉宾变成了现任播客主持人。

sentences.en: That's me.
sentences.zh: 那就是我。

sentences.en: So that's what we're going to do today.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们今天要做的。

sentences.en: And I'm going to ask Marianne lots of questions about her journey out of the D-Clin into her qualified career and then her journey into private practice.
sentences.zh: 我将问 Marianne 很多关于她从临床博士课程毕业到获得资格，再到进入私人诊所的问题。

sentences.en: And we're going to make some kind of general comparisons and maybe a few specific comparisons about those two different career paths.
sentences.zh: 我们将对这两种不同的职业道路进行一些一般性的比较，也许还会进行一些具体的比较。

sentences.en: But first, it's D-Clin application season, of course.
sentences.zh: 但首先，当然是临床心理学博士的申请季。

sentences.en: So we're all ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都准备好了。

sentences.en: One thing that we need to remind you of is that the Clearinghouse will contact your referees as soon as you save them on your application form.
sentences.zh: 我们需要提醒你的一件事是，Clearinghouse 会在你将推荐人保存到申请表上后立即联系他们。

sentences.en: That means that they will be contacted before you even finish your application and submit it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们会在你完成申请并提交之前就被联系。

sentences.en: So quick note, make sure that you get consent from your referees before you add them and save them on the form,
sentences.zh: 所以简单提醒一下，确保在添加并保存推荐人之前先征得他们的同意，

sentences.en: because Clearinghouse will take that as consent and that they're OK to contact them.
sentences.zh: 因为 Clearinghouse 会将其视为同意，并认为可以联系他们。

sentences.en: So consent first and they will get contacted before you've submitted your form.
sentences.zh: 所以先征得同意，他们会在你提交表格之前收到联系。

sentences.en: So, without further ado, welcome to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, not with Dr. Marianne Trent, but me, Thomas Gawley.
sentences.zh: 那么，废话不多说，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家》播客，今天的主持人不是 Marianne Trent 博士，而是我，Thomas Gawley。

sentences.en: And today's guest is none other than Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 今天的嘉宾正是 Marianne Trent 博士。

sentences.en: Hello, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 你好，Marianne。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I loved that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个开场。

sentences.en: That's so fun.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Very, very pleased to be here.
sentences.zh: 非常非常高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: And I feel like I'm in very capable hands.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我被照顾得很好。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: So I'm going to drop straight into it.
sentences.zh: 那我们直接进入正题吧。

sentences.en: And I'm going to take you back to the start of your third year and final year of your doctoral training.
sentences.zh: 我要带你回到你博士训练的第三年，也就是最后一年。

sentences.en: Because I guess that the start of the third year is probably also the start of the end of the training.
sentences.zh: 因为我想第三年的开始可能也是训练结束的开始。

sentences.en: And therefore, maybe a time where trainees naturally start to think about what's going to happen post qualification
sentences.zh: 因此，这可能是一个实习生自然开始思考获得资格后会发生什么的时候，

sentences.en: and what kind of routes they want to take, maybe what services, maybe they're thinking about what placements they might have wanted during third year
sentences.zh: 思考他们想走什么样的路线，可能是什么样的服务，也许他们在思考第三年期间可能想要什么样的实习，

sentences.en: and how that might lead into post qualification or not.
sentences.zh: 以及这是否会导向获得资格后的职业生涯。

sentences.en: So I guess to start, take us back to the start of third year.
sentences.zh: 所以我想先请你带我们回到第三年的开始。

sentences.en: What were you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？

sentences.en: And what were you thinking about post qualification?
sentences.zh: 你当时在考虑获得资格后的事情吗？

sentences.en: OK, great question.
sentences.zh: 好的，很好的问题。

sentences.en: So in the course or on the course, should I say, that I did, the third year is broken up into two placements,
sentences.zh: 在我所参加的课程中，第三年分为两个实习，

sentences.en: two specialist placements that you really start to pave the way for probably in year one, really.
sentences.zh: 两个专业实习，你其实从第一年就开始为之铺路了。

sentences.en: And my first specialist placement was in a wonderful, wonderful service that's since been disbanded, actually, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 我的第一个专业实习是在一个非常非常棒的服务机构，遗憾的是，它后来解散了。

sentences.en: But it was a systemic and family therapy service offering some solution focus.
sentences.zh: 那是一个系统式和家庭治疗服务，提供一些焦点解决治疗。

sentences.en: But also, yeah, like there was proper sort of family therapy rooms in there.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，那里确实有正规的家庭治疗室。

sentences.en: I don't know if you or anyone else has seen them, but they've got the one way mirrors and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你或其他任何人是否见过，但它们有单向镜，你知道的，

sentences.en: phones that you can talk through and things like that.
sentences.zh: 可以通过电话交谈之类的设备。

sentences.en: So it was in there.
sentences.zh: 所以我就在那里工作。

sentences.en: But then I also did some, had some clients for, yeah, brief solution focus, where you'd actually only offer appointments every four weeks, I think it was.
sentences.zh: 但我也有一些客户进行简短的焦点解决治疗，我想当时每四周才提供一次预约。

sentences.en: So you're really setting kind of achievable, realistic targets and goals between sessions.
sentences.zh: 所以你在会话之间设定的是可实现、现实的目标。

sentences.en: But it was also a self-referral service.
sentences.zh: 而且那也是一个自助转诊服务。

sentences.en: It's like they were doing all of the really great stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们当时在做所有非常棒的事情。

sentences.en: And also once a week on a Wednesday lunchtime, they'd do a drop-in for any difficulties you were having.
sentences.zh: 而且每周三午餐时间，他们会为你有任何困难提供一个无需预约的咨询服务。

sentences.en: I think it wasn't just linked to children, but often it would be children or parents that were brought in.
sentences.zh: 我想这不仅仅是针对儿童，但通常带进来的会是儿童或父母。

sentences.en: I think it, I can't quite remember.
sentences.zh: 我想，我记不太清了。

sentences.en: I think it might have been a specific family support drop-in.
sentences.zh: 我想那可能是一个专门的家庭支持咨询服务。

sentences.en: So literally you could come half an hour before, give your name to reception and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以你真的可以在半小时前过来，在前台登记你的名字，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: be seen for 20 minutes with a qualified psychologist to think through your difficulties and come up with a plan.
sentences.zh: 与一位合格的心理学家进行 20 分钟的咨询，思考你的困难并制定计划。

sentences.en: And then as a result of that, the clinician who'd seen would then write an assessment report and send on any referrals that were needed.
sentences.zh: 结果，接待你的临床医生会写一份评估报告，并转介任何需要的服务。

sentences.en: So you didn't hold that as a caseload.
sentences.zh: 所以你不需要把这些当作你的固定病例。

sentences.en: And if they wanted to be seen again, they could, but actually people didn't tend to.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想再次咨询也可以，但实际上人们通常不会。

sentences.en: It was such a wonderful, wonderful way of working.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常非常棒的工作方式。

sentences.en: And I learned so much and, you know, not even knowing anything, not other than someone's name before you see them.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多，你知道，在见到他们之前，除了名字什么都不知道。

sentences.en: I really learned how to think on my feet and how to think about our core skills as psychologists and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我真的学会了如何随机应变，如何思考我们作为心理学家的核心技能，你知道，

sentences.en: building rapport and trying to also probably interject when things are getting too content heavy to think that you've only got 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 建立融洽关系，并尝试在内容过多时进行干预，因为你要考虑到只有 20 分钟。

sentences.en: If by any chance they were the only people that turned up or there were other clinicians,
sentences.zh: 如果万一他们是唯一出现的人，或者有其他临床医生在场，

sentences.en: there was always other clinicians, but if it was a quiet time, then potentially you could go up to an hour.
sentences.zh: 总是有其他临床医生，但如果当时比较清闲，那么可能会延长到一个小时。

sentences.en: But really the idea was that in that hour you were seeing three clients and it was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在那一小时内你通常会见三位客户，这太棒了。

sentences.en: So that was my placement there and that was supervised by a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我在那里的实习，由一位临床心理学家监督。

sentences.en: And it was a very big team, actually.
sentences.zh: 而且那是一个非常大的团队。

sentences.en: And I think even trainee wise, there was a trainee room up in the attic.
sentences.zh: 我想即使是实习生，阁楼上也有一个实习生室。

sentences.en: And it was I think there was at different times of the week.
sentences.zh: 我想在一周的不同时间里，

sentences.en: There was probably four or five of us.
sentences.zh: 可能有四五个人。

sentences.en: So it was very busy, but I learned a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以非常忙碌，但我学到了很多。

sentences.en: And then placement six was a dynamic placement, psychodynamic, brief, brief dynamic interventions, which was something I was very interested about in my first year.
sentences.zh: 然后第六个实习是一个动力学实习，心理动力学，简短的动力学干预，这是我在第一年就非常感兴趣的事情。

sentences.en: But actually, as I develop my confidence and just you just create new interests and new ways of being, because I see placements as a way of trying on different stuff that fits.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，随着我自信心的增强，你会产生新的兴趣和新的存在方式，因为我将实习视为尝试不同适合自己的东西的一种方式。

sentences.en: And actually, by the time placement six came, I was much less interested in dynamic and probably, you know, I learned loads.
sentences.zh: 实际上，当第六个实习到来时，我对动力学的兴趣已经大大降低了，我可能学到了很多，

sentences.en: It was a great placement.
sentences.zh: 那是一个很棒的实习。

sentences.en: Everyone was really lovely to me.
sentences.zh: 每个人对我都很友善。

sentences.en: So I don't want to talk down that placement.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想贬低那个实习。

sentences.en: But certainly because of how long it takes to get into placement six, my my interest for that were less strong at that time.
sentences.zh: 但当然，因为进入第六个实习需要很长时间，我对它的兴趣在当时已经没那么强烈了。

sentences.en: And I haven't worked dynamically since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后我就没有再做过动力学方面的工作了。

sentences.en: But I guess what I love about our work is that the theory is all up there still.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我热爱我们工作的原因是，理论仍然在那里。

sentences.en: And sometimes with our integrative way of working, sometimes it will just fit.
sentences.zh: 有时通过我们整合的工作方式，有时它就会很契合。

sentences.en: And I can kind of weave in some more, you know, some more dynamic ways of working.
sentences.zh: 我可以融入一些更具动力学的工作方式。

sentences.en: But of course, alongside all of this, you have a personal life as well, don't you?
sentences.zh: 但当然，除了这一切，你还有个人生活，不是吗？

sentences.en: And you've got cohort stuff and you've got a thesis.
sentences.zh: 你有同学之间的事情，还有论文。

sentences.en: So there was a study block in between placement five and six where all sorts of things happen for context.
sentences.zh: 所以在第五和第六个实习之间有一个学习阶段，当时发生了各种各样的事情作为背景。

sentences.en: It's when William and Kate got married.
sentences.zh: 那是威廉王子和凯特王妃结婚的时候。

sentences.en: That's that sort of time.
sentences.zh: 就是那个时候。

sentences.en: It's that long ago.
sentences.zh: 那是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: And that was the end of my that was the end of my study block.
sentences.zh: 那是我学习阶段的结束。

sentences.en: I seem to recall because the rest of the world was watching the the wedding and I was beavering away on my laptop thesising.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时全世界都在看婚礼，而我正埋头在笔记本电脑上写论文。

sentences.en: So, yeah, my yeah, there was lots on my plate.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我当时有很多事情要处理。

sentences.en: But actually, personally, I was incredibly fulfilled and happy.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在个人层面上，我感到非常充实和快乐。

sentences.en: I'd been living in my new house, which is not this one for for a year.
sentences.zh: 我已经在我的新房子里住了一年了，不是现在这一栋。

sentences.en: And I'd been with my boyfriend, who is now my husband.
sentences.zh: 我当时和我的男朋友在一起，也就是现在的丈夫。

sentences.en: We had met in the first two weeks of my year to study block, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在我学习阶段的前两周认识的。

sentences.en: So that's kind of, yeah, I started the course single and then went went on the coupledom journey from year two.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我单身开始了课程，然后从第二年开始踏上了情侣之旅。

sentences.en: But, yeah, there's a very long answer to your question.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，这是一个非常长的回答。

sentences.en: Does that kind of does that answer it?
sentences.zh: 这回答了你的问题吗？

sentences.en: Does that illuminate some of what was going on for me?
sentences.zh: 这能说明我当时的一些情况吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It gives us gives us a good idea of where you're at.
sentences.zh: 这让我们很好地了解了你当时的状态。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, of course, both of those placements, I'm assuming we're in the NHS as they tend to be.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，当然，我假设这两个实习都是在 NHS，因为它们通常是这样。

sentences.en: Although I'm aware that it's it is possible to arrange their placements on some courses privately.
sentences.zh: 虽然我知道在某些课程中私下安排实习是有可能的。

sentences.en: So getting getting towards the end of your time on on the doctorate, what what were you thinking about qualification?
sentences.zh: 那么在博士课程快结束时，你在考虑获得资格后的事情吗？

sentences.en: What what did you have a job secured before you'd finished?
sentences.zh: 你在完成课程之前就已经找到工作了吗？

sentences.en: As I'm aware, most trainees I've met have that lined up.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，我遇到的大多数实习生都有安排。

sentences.en: Was that in the NHS?
sentences.zh: 那是在 NHS 吗？

sentences.en: And either way, what what was it doing?
sentences.zh: 无论如何，当时的情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: OK, so to set the context, we're talking about 2011 when I qualified.
sentences.zh: 好的，为了设定背景，我们谈论的是我 2011 年获得资格的时候。

sentences.en: And due to some kind of financial shenanigans involving various banks and mortgage companies, including Northern Rock, which no longer exists.
sentences.zh: 由于涉及各种银行和抵押贷款公司的某种金融诡计，包括不再存在的北岩银行 (Northern Rock)。

sentences.en: There was there was there was a recession which was in full swing at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时正处于经济衰退期。

sentences.en: It didn't feel as bleak as as as the 2023 landscape, actually, because we hadn't also had a global pandemic.
sentences.zh: 实际上，当时感觉并没有 2023 年的环境那么凄凉，因为我们当时还没有经历全球大流行。

sentences.en: But at that time, actually, there seemed to be cuts across services and there were very, very few jobs available.
sentences.zh: 但在那个时候，各服务部门似乎都在削减开支，可供选择的工作非常非常少。

sentences.en: So of my cohort of what started as 15 but finished as 16 due to kind of maternity leave shifts from the year above,
sentences.zh: 所以在我那一届中，虽然开始时有 15 人，但由于上一届产假调动，最后变成了 16 人，

sentences.en: only I think two people had qualified jobs to go to when the course ended in September 2011.
sentences.zh: 在 2011 年 9 月课程结束时，我想只有两个人有获得资格后的工作。

sentences.en: I guess that's unrecognisable, that situation to trainees now where you might be the only person interviewing for the job.
sentences.zh: 我想这对现在的实习生来说是不可想象的，现在你可能是唯一一个面试这份工作的人。

sentences.en: You might be the only person applying for the job.
sentences.zh: 你可能是唯一一个申请这份工作的人。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's that's a big change.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And to be honest, finding the jobs to apply to was the problem.
sentences.zh: 老实说，找工作投简历才是最大的难题。

sentences.en: There just weren't any.
sentences.zh: 根本就没什么职位空缺。

sentences.en: You know, quite often, trainees might even get jobs in their final year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多时候，实习生甚至在最后一年就能找到工作了。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes services will wait, you know, almost a year for the right candidate.
sentences.zh: 有时候，服务机构甚至愿意等上几乎一年来寻找合适的人选。

sentences.en: But it was just like, you know, to begin with, it was like, hmm, there's not really many jobs around, is there?
sentences.zh: 但当时的情况就是，一开始你会觉得，嗯，好像没什么工作机会，对吧？

sentences.en: I wonder where they're all hiding.
sentences.zh: 我真想知道它们都藏到哪儿去了。

sentences.en: Oh, I have got bills to pay.
sentences.zh: 噢，我还有账单要付呢。

sentences.en: But actually, as it went, what happened is that basically probably all of that cohort across the country began to widen their search.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，后来发生的情况是，全国范围内那一届的毕业生基本上都开始扩大了求职范围。

sentences.en: So I ended up in a role that was further away than any of my placements had been, even though the way placements are allocated, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我最终得到的工作岗位比我之前任何一个实习地点都要远，尽管实习岗位的分配方式，你知道的，

sentences.en: I never got a placement that was like right near where I lived.
sentences.zh: 我从来没被分配到离家很近的地方实习过。

sentences.en: I think my shortest commute was 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我最短的通勤时间大概是15分钟。

sentences.en: So my longest during training was probably 50 minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以实习期间最长的一次通勤大概是50分钟。

sentences.en: But my qualified commute ended up being over an hour.
sentences.zh: 但拿到资格证后的通勤时间最后超过了一个小时。

sentences.en: So all of us probably, yeah, as a as a as a just as a whole graduate cohort across the country, probably widened our search for where we were willing to consider.
sentences.zh: 所以我们所有人，作为全国范围内的一届毕业生，大概都扩大了我们愿意考虑的求职范围。

sentences.en: Um, and really, because of the, the flavor of the work I'd done, I didn't really have any strong preference to a clinical population at that point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且说实话，因为我之前做过的工作类型，当时我对临床人群并没有什么特别强烈的偏好。

sentences.en: Um, but I'd only worked, the majority of my work, including training, had been with adults.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我之前的工作，包括实习期间的大部分工作，都是针对成年人的。

sentences.en: Um, and so nobody was more surprised than me when I got a CAMHS job, um, in, in basically the heart of Birmingham, but also Sutton Coalfield.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我得到一份儿童与青少年心理健康服务（CAMHS）的工作时，没有人比我更惊讶了，那是在伯明翰的中心地带，但也属于萨顿科尔菲尔德。

sentences.en: And when I was told I was in Sutton Coalfield, I was like, I've heard of Sutton Coalfield, but I don't know where it is.
sentences.zh: 当我被告知我在萨顿科尔菲尔德工作时，我心想，我听说过萨顿科尔菲尔德，但我不知道它在哪儿。

sentences.en: Um, so nobody was more surprised than that than me, but actually I loved it and I made a great CAMHS clinician.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有人比我更惊讶了，但实际上我爱上了这份工作，并且成为了一名出色的CAMHS临床医生。

sentences.en: And what I really, really loved about CAMHS was just how energetic and joy filled the team were and how passionate about young people.
sentences.zh: 我真正非常热爱CAMHS的一点是，整个团队充满了活力和快乐，而且对年轻人充满热情。

sentences.en: And they were just really vibrant people, which might sound really strange, but, um, when I was an aspiring psychologist and certainly when I was training,
sentences.zh: 他们都是非常有活力的人，这听起来可能很奇怪，但是，嗯，当我还是个有抱负的心理学家，尤其是还在实习的时候，

sentences.en: it used to be said that if you go to, um, this is a complete overgeneralization, please don't be triggered by this anybody.
sentences.zh: 人们常说，如果你去参加——这完全是一种过度概括，请大家不要因此感到被冒犯——

sentences.en: But this is kind of some of the, just some of the, just some of the in-house conversations.
sentences.zh: 但这只是内部的一些谈话而已。

sentences.en: If you go to a substance abuse conference, um, as a professional, the bar will be rammed.
sentences.zh: 如果你以专业人士的身份去参加药物滥用会议，酒吧里肯定会挤满人。

sentences.en: Um, you know, and similarly, if you're working in an, in an adult service, the clinicians might well have some of their own struggles.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，同样地，如果你在成人服务机构工作，临床医生自己可能也会有一些挣扎。

sentences.en: Whereas working in CAMHS, everyone was just, yeah, at that point, just vibrant and, you know, really positive and optimistic in a way that was so refreshing,
sentences.zh: 而在CAMHS工作，每个人当时都非常充满活力，你知道的，那种积极乐观的态度让人感到耳目一新，

sentences.en: especially as that was my first qualified job.
sentences.zh: 尤其是因为那是我获得资格后的第一份工作。

sentences.en: And it felt, it just felt really weird, it felt really weird.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉真的很奇妙，真的很奇妙。

sentences.en: I think I've mentioned in the podcast before that I was expecting and sort of kind of hoping for kid gloves that I'd have like a,
sentences.zh: 我想我在播客里提到过，我当时期待着，甚至有点希望得到“温和对待”，希望我能有一个……

sentences.en: a period of transitioning to this new qualified role.
sentences.zh: 一个过渡到这个新专业角色的时期。

sentences.en: But my manager, who I am now good friends with, um, she was basically like, we've been waiting for you and you're qualified, away you go.
sentences.zh: 但我的经理，也就是我现在的好朋友，她基本上就是说，我们一直在等你，你已经有资格了，去干吧。

sentences.en: And I think that was empowering.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很赋能。

sentences.en: So they were thinking of me as qualified.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是把我当作有资格的专业人士来看待的。

sentences.en: I mean, in terms of, um, I don't know if CAPA still exists, but a choice and partnership approach, that's how the service worked.
sentences.zh: 我是说，关于……我不知道CAPA（选择与伙伴关系方法）现在是否还存在，但那是该服务机构的工作方式。

sentences.en: And it worked beautifully and it had won awards for patient safety.
sentences.zh: 它运作得非常完美，还赢得了患者安全奖。

sentences.en: It was a great service.
sentences.zh: 那是一个很棒的服务机构。

sentences.en: Um, but in terms of how it works with CAPA is that you don't suddenly get like 15 cases given to you.
sentences.zh: 但是关于CAPA的运作方式，你不会一下子被分配15个病例。

sentences.en: It builds week by week.
sentences.zh: 它是每周逐渐增加的。

sentences.en: So that did allow me to have more time to think, to plan, to, you know, make sure my notice board next to my desk looked nice, all those things.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实让我有更多的时间去思考、去计划，去确保我桌子旁边的公告板看起来很漂亮，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But it meant that I wasn't suddenly swamped with, with activities.
sentences.zh: 但这确实意味着我不会一下子被各种活动淹没。

sentences.en: So I did get to grow into that role.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实有机会慢慢成长以适应那个角色。

sentences.en: Whereas I think still some services might've been tempted to, you know, you're new, have this, and then juggle your new client that comes in three weeks out of four.
sentences.zh: 而我认为有些服务机构可能还是会忍不住想，你知道的，“你是新人，拿着这个”，然后让你在四分之三的时间里去应付你的新客户。

sentences.en: Um, but that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: So I was thankful for that, but I was just a qualified member of staff and expected to, to roll with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此很感激，但我只是一个有资格的员工，被期望能够应对自如。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, um, I, um, obviously being at the stage of my career, I'm at, I'm kind of focused on the transition, uh, onto the doctorate, but yeah, I'm also aware that there's,
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，嗯，我，嗯，显然处于我职业生涯的这个阶段，我有点专注于向博士学位的过渡，但我也意识到，

sentences.en: there's been another, another big transition.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个重大的转变。

sentences.en: And I know a former supervisor of mine, uh, talked about, uh, about that transition in supervision and, and kind of described it as being, you know, where,
sentences.zh: 我知道我以前的一位主管谈到过督导中的那种转变，并将其描述为，你知道，在……

sentences.en: where before you're qualified, you, you don't have ultimate clinical responsibility because you have a supervisor who is responsible for you ultimately, you know?
sentences.zh: 在你获得资格之前，你没有最终的临床责任，因为你有一位最终对你负责的主管，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Um, and he said, you know, in kind of getting registered after he'd qualified, he'd gone from Friday having no ultimate clinical responsibility to Monday,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说，在他获得资格并注册后，他从周五没有最终临床责任，变成了周一，

sentences.en: suddenly it's all on him and, uh, you know, he's got assistant as well.
sentences.zh: 突然间一切都压在他身上，而且，你知道，他还有助理。

sentences.en: So, um, yeah, I can, uh, I can imagine that's a difficult transition to, uh, uh, to make, um, but you've made that transition and you've gone into your qualified role.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，我可以想象那是一个很难完成的转变，但你已经完成了那个转变，并进入了你的专业角色。

sentences.en: So, um, I'm, I'm wondering how long were you at that CANS, uh, uh, uh, service for, and, and I suppose where, where did the, where did the journey into your own practice begin,
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我很好奇你在那个CAMHS服务机构待了多久，而且我想知道，你自己的执业之旅是从哪里开始的，

sentences.en: both in your, in your mind or your ambition, uh, was it something that you were planning to do or was it something that just kind of emerged, um, yeah, how did,
sentences.zh: 无论是在你的想法还是抱负中，这是你计划要做的事情，还是自然而然发生的？嗯，是的，它是如何……

sentences.en: how did that come about?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么发生的呢？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I was there almost four years, but that did include one little maternity leave, um, and a wedding and all the hen shenanigans that went with that.
sentences.zh: 我在那里待了近四年，但这确实包括了一次短暂的产假，还有一场婚礼以及随之而来的所有单身派对的闹剧。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, I wasn't planning on doing private work.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我没打算做私人执业。

sentences.en: So before I, um, before I, um, before I got my qualified job, I did do some brief project work, um, for organizations, which was basically sort of using my research skills, um,
sentences.zh: 在我获得专业工作之前，我确实为一些组织做过简短的项目工作，这基本上是利用我的研究技能，嗯，

sentences.en: and trying to kind of put together a report for an organization, which I did really enjoy.
sentences.zh: 并试图为某个组织整理一份报告，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: Um, but to be honest, um, the idea of private work wasn't my own, it was, um, it was offered to me as an idea, uh, by my husband.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，私人执业的想法不是我自己的，是我的丈夫向我提出的建议。

sentences.en: Um, so, um, I'd had a second, um, lot of maternity leave when I was working in an adult service.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，我在成人服务机构工作时又休了第二次产假。

sentences.en: So I left that cam service to come to a, an adult service that was closer to home.
sentences.zh: 所以我离开了那个CAMHS服务机构，去了离家更近的一家成人服务机构。

sentences.en: Um, and again, really, really valued my time there.
sentences.zh: 嗯，再次强调，我真的很珍惜在那里的时光。

sentences.en: And I learned so much and that's when I became a trauma specialist is what I would say.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多，也就是在那时，我成为了创伤专家。

sentences.en: Um, and I miss my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很想念我的同事们。

sentences.en: I do, I do, I do.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想念。

sentences.en: Um, so, and I miss my colleagues in cams as well, you know, but you can keep them as friends once you leave is what I'd say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，我也很想念CAMHS的同事们，你知道，但我想说的是，离开后你们依然可以做朋友。

sentences.en: Um, so, um, my youngest was starting, um, preschool at the school, um, and I was only by that stage working three days a week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，我的小儿子当时要开始上学前班了，而那时我每周只工作三天。

sentences.en: So after my first maternity leave, I went back to the cam service four days a week.
sentences.zh: 所以在我第一次产假结束后，我回到CAMHS服务机构每周工作四天。

sentences.en: And then when I, um, when I went back from my maternity leave for the adult service, I decided I only wanted to be three.
sentences.zh: 然后当我从成人服务机构的产假回来时，我决定我只想工作三天。

sentences.en: Um, because as anybody who works four days will tell you, you're basically doing five days work in four, four less pay.
sentences.zh: 因为任何工作四天的人都会告诉你，你基本上是在用四天的工资做五天的工作。

sentences.en: Um, so I wanted to absolutely be part time.
sentences.zh: 所以我想绝对地做兼职。

sentences.en: Um, and so, yeah, it does, it's a bit of a shock when your wages go down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，工资减少确实有点让人震惊。

sentences.en: Um, but you have to kind of cut, cut your cloth accordingly is what, um, is what my, my parents would have told me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但你必须量入为出，这是我父母会告诉我的。

sentences.en: Um, so I had those two days with, um, with my, um, well, being a parent and doing all.
sentences.zh: 所以我有那两天时间，嗯，和我的……嗯，作为一名家长，做所有……

sentences.en: The school run bits and pieces for the eldeSt.
sentences.zh: 接送大孩子上学之类的琐事。

sentences.en: But then when the youngest was going to be starting preschool, my husband was like, well, what are you going to do with those three hours a week?
sentences.zh: 但当小儿子要开始上学前班时，我丈夫就问，你每周那三个小时打算做什么？

sentences.en: Um, on a Wednesday and a Thursday.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在周三和周四。

sentences.en: And I was like, did I maybe have a nap?
sentences.zh: 我说，也许我可以小睡一会儿？

sentences.en: Maybe have a facial, tidy the house.
sentences.zh: 也许做个面部护理，打扫一下房子。

sentences.en: And he was like, you could start some private work.
sentences.zh: 他说，你可以开始做一些私人执业。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I could, but I didn't feel like a proper enough psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，噢，我可以，但我感觉自己还不够像个真正的心理学家。

sentences.en: I don't think it felt like I needed to be some, I don't know, something different.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要成为某种……我不知道，某种不同的东西。

sentences.en: Well, I didn't feel like I was it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我还没达到那个水平。

sentences.en: Um, but I was like, oh, well, yeah, maybe some more money would be nice.
sentences.zh: 但我想，噢，好吧，是的，多赚点钱也不错。

sentences.en: Um, you know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我不知道。

sentences.en: So, um, I was part of a, of a psychologist network for private professionals.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是私人执业专业人士心理学家网络的一员。

sentences.en: And I'd been part of it probably for a year.
sentences.zh: 我加入这个网络大概有一年了。

sentences.en: So I knew it was possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道这是可行的。

sentences.en: And one of my good friends, um, Cara, I know she won't mind me mentioning her.
sentences.zh: 我的一位好朋友，卡拉，我知道她不介意我提到她。

sentences.en: She was already working in private and had done for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 她已经在做私人执业了，而且做了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: And she was like, you'd be fabulous at it.
sentences.zh: 她说，你一定会做得非常棒。

sentences.en: Just, you know, do it, do it.
sentences.zh: 只要，你知道，去做吧，去做吧。

sentences.en: So, um, to cut a very long story short, um, I found myself two clinics, one that had space
sentences.zh: 所以，长话短说，我找到了两家诊所，一家周三有空位，

sentences.en: on a Wednesday, one that had space on a Thursday that were traveling distance from my children's
sentences.zh: 一家周四有空位，它们离我孩子们的学校都在车程范围内，

sentences.en: school so that I could drop them off for 8.45 and then hot foot it by car to the clinic and then see two clients, um, and then hot foot it back to the school to pick up my youngest
sentences.zh: 这样我可以在8点45分送他们去学校，然后开车赶到诊所看两个客户，嗯，然后再赶回学校接我的小儿子，

sentences.en: just in time.
sentences.zh: 刚好赶上。

sentences.en: So, um, that was quite an action packed three hours.
sentences.zh: 所以，那三个小时真是行程紧凑。

sentences.en: Um, it really was, but then the pandemic happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此，但后来疫情发生了。

sentences.en: Um, so I'd started that in September, 2019.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在2019年9月开始的。

sentences.en: And then by the time March came around, obviously it all shifted online.
sentences.zh: 到了3月份，显然一切都转到了线上。

sentences.en: And then I didn't have the school run to worry about.
sentences.zh: 然后我就不用担心接送孩子上学的问题了。

sentences.en: So I increased it to three kinds because it was increased demand because of the pandemic and then randomly ended up setting up an evening clinic one evening a week.
sentences.zh: 所以我增加到了三个客户，因为疫情导致需求增加，然后我随机地决定每周开设一个晚间诊所。

sentences.en: So before I knew it, I was then doing eight sessions a week and I was so terrified of not getting the tax right that I saved every single penny, um, other than, um, my costs and my
sentences.zh: 所以不知不觉中，我每周做八次咨询，我太害怕税务处理不当了，所以我把每一分钱都存了起来，嗯，除了我的成本和我的

sentences.en: overheads, um, for, you know, software and, you know, ICO, um, all of the, uh, insurance
sentences.zh: 管理费用，嗯，为了，你知道，软件和，你知道，ICO（信息专员办公室），嗯，所有的，呃，保险，

sentences.en: well, all of that jazz, um, because I, I didn't want to then suddenly not have enough money.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所有这些杂七杂八的东西，因为我不想突然间没钱了。

sentences.en: So it got to a position where I was like, Oh, I'm going to be a higher rate taxpayer before too long.
sentences.zh: 所以情况变成了，我心想，噢，用不了多久我就要成为高税率纳税人了。

sentences.en: I am working, working myself to the bone for actually no benefits.
sentences.zh: 我工作得筋疲力尽，实际上却没有得到任何好处。

sentences.en: Um, and so it just made me think, well, could I shift the balance slightly?
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以这让我思考，我能不能稍微调整一下平衡？

sentences.en: Could I maybe do two days in the NHS and then have, um, three days in private practice?
sentences.zh: 我能不能在NHS工作两天，然后有三天做私人执业？

sentences.en: And, you know, the pandemic, um, kind of was resolving itself.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，疫情，嗯，正在逐渐平息。

sentences.en: The kids are back at school.
sentences.zh: 孩子们又回到了学校。

sentences.en: Um, and by the time I actually went all in self-employed, it was April 2021 because my request to drop down had been declined.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我真正全职自雇时，已经是2021年4月了，因为我减少工作时间的请求被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Um, and it was interesting that sometimes, um, when we might get what we want, we might realise it's not what we want.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有趣的是，有时候，当我们得到我们想要的东西时，我们可能会意识到那并不是我们真正想要的。

sentences.en: Um, and it was actually, as I was doing my appeal for that, that I suddenly realised if they say yes, I think I might be a bit disappointed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，当我为那个请求进行申诉时，我突然意识到，如果他们答应了，我想我可能会有点失望。

sentences.en: I might be a bit sad.
sentences.zh: 我可能会有点难过。

sentences.en: Um, and I think that that speaks volumes, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这说明了一切，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because if you then get what you want and you still don't want it, maybe that's not what, you know, that's not the course of action you should be taking.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你得到了你想要的，却发现你依然不想要它，也许那不是你应该采取的行动方案。

sentences.en: So I did then make the decision to go all in, which is, you know, not an easy decision.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终决定全职投入，这，你知道，不是一个容易的决定。

sentences.en: Someone on my cohort had always planned to be a trainee and then set up their own practice.
sentences.zh: 我那一届的某个人一直计划着实习，然后建立自己的诊所。

sentences.en: And that is what they did, um, right from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们所做的，嗯，从一开始就是这样。

sentences.en: And to watch that going on as someone that was newly qualified, it was like, oh, gosh, that feels like, oh, wild.
sentences.zh: 作为一个刚获得资格的人，看着这一切发生，感觉就像，噢，天哪，这感觉，噢，太疯狂了。

sentences.en: You know, they had a website and everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们有网站，什么都有。

sentences.en: Um, so to, to kind of go through that process myself, but, but no, I already could pay my bills if needed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，亲自经历那个过程，但，但不是，如果需要的话，我已经可以支付我的账单了。

sentences.en: You know, I got my, my, my accountant to help me calculate what, what I needed as a bare minimum, um, to kind of make my ends meet and still pay my tax and my national insurance
sentences.zh: 你知道，我让我的会计帮我计算我作为最低限度需要多少钱，嗯，来维持收支平衡，同时还要支付我的税款和国民保险，

sentences.en: and all of that jazz and to actually take out, um, any passive assets at that time.
sentences.zh: 以及所有那些杂七杂八的东西，并且在当时实际取出任何被动资产。

sentences.en: So by that time I did have the tricky brain kit and the grief collective book and a couple of different bits and pieces.
sentences.zh: 所以到那时，我确实有了“棘手大脑工具包”和《悲伤集体》这本书以及其他一些零零碎碎的东西。

sentences.en: Um, but if we took that out, but it's not as predictable as regular one-to-one client work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但如果我们把那些去掉，它不像常规的一对一客户工作那样可预测。

sentences.en: So we took that off the table and kind of helped me have a figure for how many clients I needed to see a week.
sentences.zh: 所以我们把它排除在外，这帮我算出了我每周需要看多少客户的数字。

sentences.en: So that's where I started.
sentences.zh: 这就是我开始的地方。

sentences.en: Um, but it still feels like a big deal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但这仍然感觉是一件大事。

sentences.en: Um, and I would say that I never felt alone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想说的是，我从来没有感到孤独。

sentences.en: So people are like, won't you be lonely?
sentences.zh: 所以人们会问，你不会感到孤独吗？

sentences.en: But actually my accountant is so lovely.
sentences.zh: 但实际上我的会计非常可爱。

sentences.en: She feels like part of my team.
sentences.zh: 她感觉就像我团队的一部分。

sentences.en: Um, and I've got a virtual assistant, Hannah, who helps me do bits and pieces for socials and keeps me on track and thinking, I haven't got any content planned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我还有一位虚拟助理汉娜，她帮我处理社交媒体的琐事，让我保持正轨，并提醒我，我还没计划任何内容。

sentences.en: I haven't got any content planned.
sentences.zh: 我还没计划任何内容。

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: Um, and so at that time we were running regular five-day challenges for people with complex trauma.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以当时我们正在为复杂创伤患者举办定期的五天挑战。

sentences.en: And so, um, yeah, I think Hannah and I were doing more work together at that time because there's lots involved in running a challenge.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，我想汉娜和我当时在一起工作得更多，因为举办一个挑战赛涉及很多事情。

sentences.en: Um, so I never felt by myself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我从来没有感到孤身一人。

sentences.en: I've never felt lonely.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有感到孤独。

sentences.en: Um, and of course, when you're seeing clients, you are connecting with people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，当你接待客户时，你是在与人建立联系。

sentences.en: And I have done some networking here and there and I'm part of various groups, but, you know, I still talk to Cara most days, um, and other kind of psychologist friends as well.
sentences.zh: 我也在这里和那里做了一些社交，我是各种小组的一员，但是，你知道，我仍然每天都和卡拉聊天，嗯，还有其他一些心理学家朋友。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's a very long answer to your question again, but that's, that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这又是对你问题的长篇大论，但这就是发生的事情。

sentences.en: I'm just going to, going to take that, um, that the kind of, you don't feel lonely, but, um, you also mentioned during the camp that, that you really miss the people you worked
sentences.zh: 我只是想，想接受这一点，嗯，那种，你不感到孤独，但是，嗯，你也提到在CAMHS期间，你真的很想念你一起工作的人，

sentences.en: with in, in the services as well.
sentences.zh: 在服务机构里也是如此。

sentences.en: Um, and I know from my, from my own experience, I, I feel like part of my, um, continuous development
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且我知道从我自己的经验来看，我觉得我的一部分，嗯，持续发展，

sentences.en: has happened in kind of what a kind of informal micro supervisions, just these passing conversations
sentences.zh: 发生在那种非正式的微型督导中，就是这些擦肩而过的谈话。

sentences.en: or, um, in my role as an AP, I was really fortunate that we always had two trainees, um, in the
sentences.zh: 或者，嗯，在我担任助理心理学家（AP）期间，我真的很幸运，因为我们团队里总是有两名实习生，

sentences.en: team and we, we had a, had our own room, um, and they would, they would come in from a session
sentences.zh: 我们有自己的办公室，他们会从咨询室出来，

sentences.en: and there'd be, you know, quite often there'd be, everyone would turn their chairs around and there'd be like a little kind of debrief and sort of sharing ideas.
sentences.zh: 通常大家会把椅子转过来，进行一个小型的汇报交流，分享一下想法。

sentences.en: Um, we also did a, a balance group as well every month for the whole team, which would be six of us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们每个月还会为整个团队进行一次“巴林特小组”（Balance group）活动，总共六个人。

sentences.en: Um, so for anyone who doesn't know what a balance group is, it's a, a basic, a case discussion that's unprepared.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于不知道什么是巴林特小组的人来说，它基本上就是一种未经准备的案例讨论。

sentences.en: So one person presents a case, generally something that they're really stuck with and that can
sentences.zh: 所以，一个人会提出一个案例，通常是他们感到非常棘手的，

sentences.en: be either with a client or working with another team or working with a system, but something where they're stuck and the progress of the work is, is kind of, uh, become difficult.
sentences.zh: 可能是关于客户的，也可能是与另一个团队或系统合作时遇到的，总之是他们卡住、工作进展变得困难的情况。

sentences.en: Um, they present that for 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们会用10分钟来陈述这个案例。

sentences.en: How do you spell that, Thomas?
sentences.zh: 那个词怎么拼，Thomas？

sentences.en: I've not heard of that before.
sentences.zh: 我以前没听说过。

sentences.en: Is it B?
sentences.zh: 是B开头吗？

sentences.en: Balance?
sentences.zh: Balance？

sentences.en: It's B-A-L-I-N-T.
sentences.zh: 是B-A-L-I-N-T。

sentences.en: I think it's named after a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我想它是以一位心理学家命名的。

sentences.en: So it comes from the, around the mid-century, I think.
sentences.zh: 它起源于世纪中叶左右，我想。

sentences.en: It was a group of psychologists who, um, who created this group in order to kind of have, have supervision and share ideas, uh, and develop their, their thinking.
sentences.zh: 那是一群心理学家，嗯，为了获得督导、分享想法并发展他们的思维而创建了这个小组。

sentences.en: Um, it's really, yeah, it's a really good learning session.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是一个非常好的学习环节。

sentences.en: I always, I always felt, um, I think I, generally I felt kind of, uh, I think I, I felt perceptibly developed as a clinician after each one of those sessions.
sentences.zh: 我总是，我总是觉得，嗯，我觉得在每次这样的会议之后，作为一名临床医生，我都能感觉到自己的进步。

sentences.en: Um, but in terms of just those informal little chats that, that kind of go on, that there's a kind of drip, um, drip, drip effect of, of development through those.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但就那些持续进行的非正式小谈话而言，它们有一种点滴积累的成长效应。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering, you know, when you're saying you miss the services, do you, how do you, how do you compensate by what, by working as a kind of lone private clinician?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，当你提到你怀念那些服务时，你是如何通过作为一名孤独的私人临床医生来补偿的呢？

sentences.en: How, how do you compensate for that?
sentences.zh: 你是如何补偿这一点的？

sentences.en: Yeah, good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好问题。

sentences.en: I'm very perceptive of you if you've noticed what I'd said and then there being a bit of a disparity there.
sentences.zh: 你观察得很敏锐，竟然注意到了我刚才说的话，并发现了其中的一点差异。

sentences.en: So, um, it's very tricky because in my CAMS service, I had my own office and if you're busy, you can shut the door, um, which is quite, quite clear communication, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，这很棘手，因为在我的儿童与青少年心理健康服务（CAMS）工作中，我有自己的办公室，如果你很忙，可以关上门，嗯，这是一种非常明确的沟通方式，不是吗？

sentences.en: Um, whereas in my, um, adult service, I didn't even have my own chair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而在我的成人服务工作中，我甚至连自己的椅子都没有。

sentences.en: So it was agile working, but in an environment where there wasn't even really room for all the clinicians that were there.
sentences.zh: 所以那是敏捷办公，但在一个甚至没有足够空间容纳所有临床医生的环境中。

sentences.en: Um, but at that point they weren't that hot on you working from home until the pandemic happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但在那之前，直到疫情发生，他们对居家办公并不怎么热衷。

sentences.en: And then obviously everything became deathly quiet.
sentences.zh: 然后显而易见，一切都变得死一般的寂静。

sentences.en: Um, but I have always in my qualified capacity and in my assistant and aspiring capacity, being a real grafter, I will, you know, I will take on cases.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我一直以来，无论是在我有资格的职位上，还是在担任助理和实习期间，都是一个非常勤奋的人，我会，你知道，我会承担案例。

sentences.en: I will fill my caseload.
sentences.zh: 我会填满我的病例量。

sentences.en: We used to work with a job plan model as part of CAPA and that's something that's followed me through my career and I still have now.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常使用CAPA模式下的工作计划模型，这在我职业生涯中一直伴随着我，我现在依然在使用。

sentences.en: So I was recruited to the 8A post, um, in adults to do 50% face-to-face clinical time.
sentences.zh: 所以我被招募到成人服务部门担任8A级职位，嗯，要求进行50%的面对面临床工作时间。

sentences.en: And when I started, I was sort of told by another clinician, oh, it's not possible because you can't get the rooMs.
sentences.zh: 当我开始工作时，另一位临床医生告诉我，哦，这不可能，因为你找不到房间。

sentences.en: Um, you know, you just can't see people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，你就是没法见到人。

sentences.en: I've only seen probably one or two people this year, um, because you can't get the rooms because the rooms were given out to people all across the trust, not just to the
sentences.zh: 今年我大概只见过一两个人，嗯，因为你找不到房间，因为房间被分配给了整个信托机构的人，而不仅仅是那些在楼里工作的人，这再次让我觉得需要自己想办法。

sentences.en: people that worked in the building, which again, I think needed me working.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我当时想，好吧，我被雇佣就是为了做面对面的工作。

sentences.en: Um, so I was like, well, I've been employed to do face-to-face time.
sentences.zh: 我一定要做到。

sentences.en: I'm going to do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我跑遍了整个城市去找房间。

sentences.en: Um, so I went all over the city getting rooMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不总是待在那里，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So I wasn't always there, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以当我见到人们时，那是一段非常美好的连接时光。

sentences.en: So when I saw people, it was a really nice connection time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，我在那里工作的第一年，嗯，我只有周二下午在基地。

sentences.en: Um, and actually in my first year of working there, um, I only was at base on a Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是我唯一能与人交流的时间。

sentences.en: Um, that's the only time that I had to connect with people.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我习惯了大部分时间通过WhatsApp、短信或电子邮件与同事联系。

sentences.en: So, um, I was used to lots of my time with my colleagues being via WhatsApp or text message or emails.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，现在在隔离状态下工作，感觉并没有太大的不同。

sentences.en: So, um, actually working now in isolation, it doesn't feel hugely different.
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，当我休完第二个产假回来时，确实感觉不同，我只有两个孩子。

sentences.en: So it, it did when I went back from my second maternity leave, I have only got two kids.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很小心地给自己留出更多时间，嗯，与同事相处，我一直非常喜欢，嗯，与有抱负的心理学家一起工作。

sentences.en: Um, I was careful to give myself more time, um, with my colleagues and I've always really loved, uh, working with aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢花时间和实习生在一起。

sentences.en: So I loved spending time with trainees.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢花时间和助理在一起，而且我显然已经能够将这一点融入到我目前的工作模式中，这样我仍然能获得我非常享受且擅长的部分。

sentences.en: Um, I loved spending times with assistants and I've been able to obviously weave that into my current working model so that I'm still getting that aspect of something that
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，我仍然有督导。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed and that I was good at as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一位负责EMDR工作的督导，还有一位负责我常规实践的督导，不是专门针对EMDR的。

sentences.en: Um, and of course I've still got supervisors.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的年龄也有所不同。

sentences.en: So I've got a supervisor for my EMDR work and I've got a supervisor for my generic practice, not specifically linked to EMDr.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我的常规督导是一位，嗯，一位上了年纪的资深人士。

sentences.en: And there's a mixture of ages there as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的很喜欢他，喜欢他对事物的看法，而且我们确实有。

sentences.en: So, um, my generic supervisor is an, um, an advanced, a man in advancing age.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不同的个人经历和职业经历，以及他所带来的东西。

sentences.en: Um, and I really love his, just his view on things and that we do have.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，是的，你知道，我仍然与人保持联系，而且因为我已经更多地转向，我现在会称自己为一名女商人，同时也是一名心理学家。

sentences.en: Um, different personal experiences and professional experiences and what he brings to that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几年前，这会让我感到恶心，嗯，因为我当时对这个想法并不舒服，但现在我已经进入了那些网络。

sentences.en: But, um, yeah, so, you know, I am still in contact with people and because I've moved more into, I would now call myself a business woman as well as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我也在，你知道，在商业世界中建立联系。

sentences.en: And actually a few years ago, that would have made me sick in my mouth, um, because it, I wasn't comfortable with that, with that idea because I've now moved into those networks.
sentences.zh: 我感觉，是的，他们也是我的同事。

sentences.en: I'm also kind of, you know, making contacts in the business world as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我确实会进行一些面对面的社交，也会参加一些社交活动。

sentences.en: And I'm feeling kind of, yeah, that they're my colleagues as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我刚从戈尔韦回来，在那里做了面对面的主题演讲。

sentences.en: So it is, you know, I do do some networking in person and I do do some networking events.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但对我来说，我喜欢独处。

sentences.en: Um, and I'm just freshly back from Galway doing a keynote speech in person.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我是一个很好的陪伴。

sentences.en: Um, but for me, I like my own company.
sentences.zh: 我总是能做出极好的活动选择。

sentences.zh: 如果还有其他人对播客内容有什么想法，请随时告诉我。

sentences.en: Or if anyone wants Thomas to grill me on anything else, let me know.
sentences.zh: 或者如果有人想让Thomas在其他方面盘问我，也请告诉我。

sentences.en: And I'm sure we can sort that out as well, but you are about to start your journey, um, as a trainee.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们也能安排好，但你即将开始你的实习生之旅了。

sentences.en: In fact, by the time this comes out, you will be in your teaching book.
sentences.zh: 事实上，等这期节目发布时，你已经在你的教学书里了。

sentences.en: So I hope it goes so well for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望一切顺利。

sentences.en: Thank you again for your time, Thomas.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你的时间，Thomas。

sentences.en: And thank you to our listeners for listening.
sentences.zh: 也感谢我们的听众收听。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Max, I work as an assistant psychologist in the learning disability service in West Yorkshire.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是Max，我在西约克郡的学习障碍服务部门担任助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Like most people working in psychology, I'm slowly but surely waking myself up to that seemingly impossible goal of getting onto the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 像大多数从事心理学工作的人一样，我正在慢慢地、坚定地唤醒自己，去追求那个看似不可能的目标——考取临床心理学博士学位。

sentences.en: With that end goal in mind, I thought
sentences.zh: 怀着这个最终目标，我想

sentences.en: I'd have a look at what's out there and see what books might be helpful for this.
sentences.zh: 看看市面上有什么书能对此有所帮助。

sentences.en: I came across
sentences.zh: 我偶然发现了

sentences.en: Marian's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and decided that this would be a great buy for me to help me on my journey.
sentences.zh: Marianne的书《临床心理学家集体》，并决定买下它来帮助我的旅程。

sentences.en: I found Marian's book really informative, most insightful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得Marianne的书非常有信息量，非常有洞察力。

sentences.en: I especially liked how the stories reassured me that you don't need to be academically perfect to become a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢书中的故事，它们让我确信，成为一名心理学家并不需要学术上完美，

sentences.en: and that as long as you have good interpersonal skills, such as compassion and empathy, you will get there.
sentences.zh: 只要你有良好的人际交往能力，比如同情心和共情能力，你就能成功。

sentences.en: I would highly recommend this book to all aspiring psychologists, and also those who want
sentences.zh: 我强烈向所有有志于成为心理学家的人推荐这本书，也推荐给那些想

sentences.en: to know a bit more about the world of clinical psychology, and maybe want to work in that field one day.
sentences.zh: 多了解临床心理学世界，并希望有一天能在这个领域工作的人。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到用时间换金钱之外的钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne
sentences.zh: 我是Dr. Marianne

sentences.en: Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: Trent，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的One2Money项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt. That includes six months of WhatsApp support,
